rationale: v1 showed that a permanent leverage sleeve produced development excess but concentrated it in one year. v2 changes only the leverage budget: it adds exposure in calm positive-momentum risk-on months and removes it when short-horizon volatility is high or momentum is non-positive. Thresholds are fixed economically without a parameter sweep.

signals.base_risk_state: frozen K200LowTurnoverReentry defaults using only KODEX 200 split-adjusted history
signals.overlay_review_frequency: first KRX session of each month
signals.momentum: 60-session KODEX 200 close return must be positive for any leveraged sleeve
signals.volatility: 20-session KODEX 200 close-return standard deviation annualised with sqrt(252)
signals.execution: a changed tier executes at the current first-session open using the previous close signal

execution.kodex_leverage_holding_period_tax: 15.4 percent of the positive minimum of simulated market-price gain and official tax-NAV gain, charged on each sale
execution.cash_distributions: official payment events with 15.4 percent withholding on the taxable amount

decision_rule: Any development gate failure rejects v2 without opening either sealed period. Passing development opens only the 2023-2024 walk-forward period.
